title: Kestrel Rx Savings Club Terms: Loyalty Points on the Renewal Fee — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
**Clause.** The Kestrel Rx Savings Club renewal fee's loyalty points under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs are set by the fee charges standing on the membership when the renewal fee is worked out, counted as every fee charge booked less every fee charge refunded: **4 or more** standing charges earn **15 points off**, **exactly 3** standing charges earn **10 points off**, and fewer earn none.

**What a point is.** A point off is one percentage point off the enrollment fee in the renewal fee for the membership term. The renewal fee's points off are first added into one total percentage, and the enrollment fee is reduced once by that total percentage and rounded to the cent half up; the points never act one after another.

**When the count is taken.** The standing charges are counted on the membership's fee history as it stands at the moment the renewal fee is worked out; every fee charge booked is counted and every refunded fee charge is taken off.

| Standing fee charges when the renewal fee is worked out | Loyalty points off |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 15 |
| exactly 3 | 10 |
| 2 or fewer | 0 |

**Hypothetical fee histories.**

- 4 charges booked, none refunded: 4 standing, 15 points off.
- 4 charges booked, 1 refunded: 3 standing, 10 points off.
- 3 charges booked, 1 refunded: 2 standing, no points.
